_comment: The one damage-type vocabulary. Every `damage_type` in spells.json, statuses.json, zones.json and auras.json, every key in a `resistances` block, and every literal passed to CombatManager.apply_damage() is one of these names — validate_data.py checks all four against this file.
_comment_why: There were three vocabularies before, and they disagreed. PHYSICAL_SUBTYPES knew about slashing/crushing/piercing; MAGIC_DAMAGE_TYPES listed holy, shadow and arcane, which nothing deals, and omitted black and white, which eleven and four spells deal; and the `damage_type` field itself was an open string, so five spells dealt `ice` while every resistance in the game said `cold`. Nothing could notice, because `.get(key, 0)` answers a missing key with zero resistance.
_comment_compounds: A compound type is dealt as its components in equal shares: a `solar` hit is half white and half fire, each half resisted separately. That is what makes a compound worth having — it is hard to wall off with one resistance and gains nothing against a defender who resists neither. `components` is the mechanic; the NAME is flavour, which is why white_fire and solar are both white+fire. A funeral pyre is not sunlight.
_comment_magic: `magic: true` is what the Yoga table's magic_resistance_pct applies to — equanimity in the face of sorcery. Physical damage is not on the list, and neither is poison: equanimity does not thin venom.

physical.name: Physical
physical.description: Force applied to a body. The fallback for every subtype.

slashing.name: Slashing
slashing.description: Edges. Falls back to physical resistance where a unit declares none of its own.

crushing.name: Crushing
crushing.description: Weight and impact. What a skeleton fears.

piercing.name: Piercing
piercing.description: Points. What armour turns and flesh does not.

space.name: Space
space.description: Distance folded, void, the gap between things.

ice.name: Ice
ice.description: Cold as a weapon. Called `cold` in the data for months while every spell dealt `ice`, which is exactly the kind of gap this file exists to close.

white.name: White
white.description: Radiance. What the undead flinch from.

black.name: Black
black.description: Decay, curse, the appetite of the grave.

poison.name: Poison
poison.description: Venom and rot working through a body. Not magic: equanimity is no antidote.

solar.name: Solar
solar.description: Sunlight given weight — half radiance, half heat.

white_fire.name: White Fire
white_fire.description: Sacred flame. The same halves as solar, and a different thing to stand in front of.

fire_black.name: Hellfire
fire_black.description: Flame that curses what it burns.

physical_fire.name: Burning Debris
physical_fire.description: Rock and flame arriving together — a meteor is both.

prismatic.name: Prismatic
prismatic.description: All five elements at once, a fifth each. Sovereign Oil is the only thing that does it, and nothing walls it off.

random_elemental.name: Random Element
random_elemental.description: One of the five, chosen afresh each time it lands — the Rainbow spells. Rolled at the moment of damage, so the same cast can hit two targets with two elements.

none.name: None
none.description: Deals no damage. Smoke bombs and summons whose attack is a status, not a wound.

true.name: True
true.description: Damage that answers to nothing. Reserved for effects that have already decided the outcome — an execute is not a hit that could be resisted.

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.description: Self-inflicted, by ritual. Armour does not stop a knife you are holding yourself — Chöd's call site has said so in a comment since it was written, while the armour table quietly reduced it anyway.

_comment_other: Resistance keys that are NOT damage types. They belong to other systems that happen to use the same word, and the validator knows to leave them alone.

other_resistances.disease: Afflictions, read by WoundSystem._resisted() as a chance to shrug one off. Never reduces damage.
other_resistances.bleed: An affliction, like disease: Stone Body's +25% is a chance not to start bleeding, not a discount on the damage once you are. NOTHING READS IT YET — PerkSystem writes it into derived.resistances and no code asks for it. Resistance.affliction() is where it belongs; recorded in TODO so it is not lost.
other_resistances.ranged: How the damage arrived rather than what it was — Silk armour turns arrows whatever they are made of. The same axis as the Air_Shield status's ranged_damage_reduction, and read in the attack path rather than by damage type.
